description.value: The Jewish Community Centre of Victoria (JCCV) is a charitable, non-profit organization founded in 1988 that serves both the Jewish community and the broader public with educational, cultural, and social programs. The centre hosts the Lox, Stock & Bagel Deli — a kosher-style lunch spot with dine-in and take-out options — alongside a Judaica gift shop, library, and the annual Victoria International Jewish Film Festival, now in its 12th year. A touring cyclist stopping here would find a welcoming community hub with a distinctive deli meal and a slice of Victoria's cultural life.
